title: Free-sheaf homology of a Cech nerve
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, let $F\to G$ be a morphism of presheaves of sets which becomes surjective after sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and let $K_n=F\times_G\cdots\times_G F$ with $n+1$ factors and the usual face and degeneracy maps. For a commutative ring $R$, let $R[K_n]^\#$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf of free $R$-modules on $K_n$. Then the alternating-face complex has $H_i=0$ for $i>0$, and its augmentation identifies $H_0$ with $R[G]^\#$.

source.place: Hypercoverings, Lemma Tag 01GC (label lemma-compare-cosk0), lines 582-647. Proof route: let G' be the presheaf image of F to G. Each fibre of its Cech nerve is the nerve of a nonempty set and contracts after choosing one preimage; the free-R chain complex is homotopy equivalent to the free-R complex on G'. Sheafification is exact for modules and G'^#=G^# by local surjectivity. The free-R variant uses the same simplicial contraction.
